topography.project_purpose: Ribbon Finance is a DeFi protocol offering structured products that generate yield through automated options strategies and lending. It provides vaults that execute covered calls, put selling, and other option-based strategies, as well as fixed-rate lending products, allowing users to deposit assets and earn returns.
topography.relationship_narrative: Theta Vaults and Ribbon Earn share the RibbonFactory for deployment and management, while Ribbon Lend uses its own PoolFactory and PoolMaster infrastructure. The RBN token is used across Liquidity Gauges for rewards and may be involved in governance via the Ribbon DAO.
